description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations -  Notify the Memorandum of understanding entered into between Finlays Colombo Limited and United Tea, Rubber & Local Produce Workers Union ; International  Distillers Limited and the Food, Beverages & Tobacco Industrial Employees Union and the collective Agreement between  Lanka Walltiles PLC and Inter Company Employees Union
reasoning: This gazette content publishes a Memorandum of Understanding between a company and a workers' union under the Industrial Disputes Act, Chapter 131. It contains detailed regulatory provisions regarding employment terms, loans, benefits, and working conditions. This falls under legal/regulatory matters as it involves the formal publication of a settlement agreement that has legal force under existing labor legislation, making it a statutory instrument rather than a government personnel or organizational matter.
